## Arithmetic with precedence: * binds tighter than +, both
## left-associative. The grammar is WRITTEN left-recursively — the
## compiler rewrites it into tier rules at compile time (the ANTLR 4
## model), so the artifact carries plain atoms every engine runs
## identically.
grammar Calculator version "1.0.0" edition "v1" {
  ## digit runs are the numbers; spaces allowed between tokens.
  number = ( 1*( %x30-39 ) ) as num
  ws = *( %x20 )
  expr = expr ( ws "*" ws expr ) as mul / expr ( ws "+" ws expr ) as add / number
  ## The capture wrapper: binds the whole tree as `expr`.
  top = ( expr ) as expr

  entry main: top

  test {
    accept "1+2*3"
    accept "10*20+30"
    shape "1+2*3" { expr: [ { num: "1" },
      { add: [ { num: "2" }, { mul: { num: "3" } } ] } ] }
    reject "+1"
  }
}
